Why did Arjuna's chariot burst into flames? After eighteen days of war, Arjuna had won. As the story goes, Krishna stopped the chariot and said, Arjuna, get down first.

Arjuna was surprised. The charioteer always gets down first. But he obeyed. Then Hanuman, on the flag, bowed and vanished. Krishna stepped down. And the moment his feet touched the ground, the chariot burst into flames.
Wait, why? For eighteen days, the deadliest weapons had hit that chariot. Only Krishna sitting on it had held them back. The moment he left, the chariot burned.
That's why we say, as long as he holds the reins, nothing can touch you. Comment Jai Shri Krishna if he is holding yours.
